# CopilotForge - Organisation Tailoring

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Turn an organisation profile into a recommended edition and maturity archetype, a scaled programme, an ownership map and a transformation pack.

- **Layer:** spanning
- **Lead role:** Transformation Architect
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-organisation-tailoring`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ai-profile-intake`](skills/ai-profile-intake/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover | Creates or validates an organisation profile - size, business units, regulatory context, Microsoft estate, current AI use, knowledge, governance, adoption and delivery capability - by short interview or from a file, capturing only what tailoring needs and marking unknowns. Use when someone asks for help with an AI programme and no profile exists, when a profile file is supplied, or when circumstances have changed since the last pack. |
| [`ai-role-catalogue`](skills/ai-role-catalogue/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable, Scale | Maintains the catalogue of AI transformation roles - department lead roles plus sponsor, business, knowledge, solution and reviewer roles - each with purpose, responsibilities, decisions, capabilities, separation rules and typical time, and maps them to the job roles the organisation has declared. Use when an operating model names roles nobody recognises, when job titles must be matched to AI roles, or when the catalogue needs updating. |
| [`capability-gap-analysis`](skills/capability-gap-analysis/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Mobilise, Scale | Compares what the recommended AI programme demands - capabilities and time by role and quarter - with what the organisation has declared, classifies each shortfall as capability, capacity or vacancy, and chooses how to close it (develop, recruit, partner, borrow, re-sequence or defer) with the effect on the programme. Use when a pack or roadmap looks unstaffable, when capacity is the stated constraint, or before committing to delivery dates. |
| [`edition-and-archetype`](skills/edition-and-archetype/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision | Applies the CopilotForge tailoring rules to a validated organisation profile to recommend an edition (starter, scale or enterprise), an assurance overlay and a maturity archetype, citing the rule id behind each, reporting emerging signals and explaining the result to the sponsor before any pack is built. Use when a profile is ready, when a sponsor asks why they got a lighter or heavier programme, or when circumstances change. |
| [`operating-model-tailoring`](skills/operating-model-tailoring/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Mobilise | Right-sizes the AI target operating model for one organisation from its confirmed edition, overlay, archetype, signals and declared constraints - which structures to adopt now, which roles to combine, which forums to merge, what a partner covers, what to defer and what would trigger a change - each decision traced to a rule or constraint. Use when a generic operating model looks too heavy or too light, or when constraints change. |
| [`ownership-map`](skills/ownership-map/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise | Produces a role-based ownership map for an AI programme from declared roles only - the accountable role for each engaged department and each pack artefact, named owners only where the organisation has declared them, and roles left without an owner. Use when a transformation pack needs owners, when a sponsor asks who will do this work, or when nobody can say who owns adoption, governance or agents. |
| [`transformation-pack-refresh`](skills/transformation-pack-refresh/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Scale, Improve | Refreshes an existing transformation pack when the organisation's profile, signals or the CopilotForge library change - compares old and new profiles and tailoring results, classifies each change as material or minor, maps it to affected artefacts, protects decisions already taken, and agrees a change summary before any document is replaced. Use when a pack is due for review, after a merger or new regulation, or when agents or shadow AI appear. |
| [`transformation-pack`](skills/transformation-pack/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision, Mobilise, Enable, Deliver, Assure, Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve | Orchestrates a tailored AI transformation pack from a confirmed profile - assessment, target operating model, adoption and Champions programmes, CoE, opportunity process, agent delivery, governance, roadmap, ownership map, templates and success measures - at the depth the edition sets, each artefact naming its responsible skill and sources. Use when an organisation asks for help adopting Copilot, scaling agents or setting up an AI CoE. |
